posts.caption: AF2.6 Admissions access: the finding, not the fix, 15 October 2026
posts.comment:
READY FOR ALI REVIEW - DOCUMENT. AF2.6, Admissions access: the finding, not the fix.

The ticket asked: Map the admissions admin prefix into the section gate and give Taiwo a scoped login. Delivered: Neither, because the premise was wrong. Taiwo is not blocked and never was, and mapping the prefix would have changed nothing for anybody.

This is a BACKFILL. The work shipped in #3100 and the finding was real, but the artifact was never filed where the ticket said it would be, which is the gap your rule closes. The document carries the measured figures, the diagram, and a section stating what the work does NOT establish.

It also keeps what I got wrong first, rather than quietly overwriting it.

Review state unchanged. I do not close tickets.
